Title:Land Transport Authority of Singapore (Amendment) Bill
MPs Speaking:The Minister for Transport (Mr Lui Tuck Yew) Mr Lui Tuck Yew, Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Pasir Ris-Punggol) Mr Gan Thiam Poh, Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied), Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Non-Constituency Member), Asst Prof Tan Kheng Boon Eugene (Nominated Member), Mrs Lina Chiam (Non-Constituency Member), Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon), Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang), Dr Janil Puthucheary (Pasir Ris-Punggol)

Land Transport Authority of Singapore (Amendment) Bill

Order for Second Reading read.

5.01 pm

Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Pasir Ris-Punggol): Mr Speaker, Sir, thank you for allowing me to join the debate. I will speak in Mandarin first.

(In Mandarin): [Please refer to Pg 368-369 for Vernacular Speeches.] Mr Speaker, Sir, food, clothing, shelter and transport are basic necessities of life. People have been seeking a perfect transport solution that is convenient, fast, safe, reliable and economical. In ancient times, people looked for horses that run a thousand miles a day, while in current times, we look to MRTs and high speed trains.
